en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a close-up of Gothic stone sculptures on the façade of a cathedral. Four standing figures in draped robes are set in ornate vertical niches with intricate architectural canopies above and decorative carvings below. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as part of Strasbourg Cathedral and describes the figures as the fiancé and the wise virgins.
